MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

3. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

4. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

7. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

9. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.

10. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

11. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Media Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
